about: Copy the shape you need into episode.json → data. Every number on screen or in the voice must be one of these, and every EPFO rule or step the reel relies on is a rule item.

examples.label: Months without a job before the whole PF can be withdrawn
examples.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 49(2), first proviso (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
examples.check_note: Gazette pp. 90–91: a member isn't eligible 'unless the member has not been employed ... for a continuous period of not less than twelve months immediately preceding the date of application'. The old 1952 Scheme said 2 months. Exceptions in para 49(1) and the second proviso (marriage) don't change the reel's case.

examples.label: EPFO's services are free
examples.statement: EPFO's services are free: members shouldn't pay any fee to agents or cyber cafes.
examples.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 16 June 2025
examples.check_note: Find: members 'should not pay any fees to third party agents or cyber cafes' for EPFO's services.

fact_note: Only a person checks a fact or a rule: checked_by is a person's name, set with tools/approve.py fact. Muse finds and links the official source, and never signs it off.
rule_note: A rule has a statement instead of a value and a unit. Sources are EPFO's own pages, circulars and the Gazette, never news or videos.
